sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Over the past 48 hours, President Trump banned DEI programming in the federal government, punished three former aides by taking away their security detail,
sentences.zh: 在过去的48小时里，特朗普总统禁止了联邦政府中的多元、平等与包容项目，通过剥夺安全保卫人员惩罚了三位前助手，

sentences.en: and celebrated the release of hundreds of January 6th rioters and planners.
sentences.zh: 并庆祝数百名1月6日骚乱者和策划者获释。

sentences.en: Today, I talked through all of that with three of my Times colleagues,
sentences.zh: 今天，我与我的三位时报同事深入探讨了这一切，

sentences.en: White House reporters Maggie Haberman, Zolin Kano-Youngs, and David Sanger.
sentences.zh: 白宫记者玛吉·哈伯曼、佐林·卡诺-杨斯和大卫·萨格尔。

sentences.en: Friday, January 24th.
sentences.zh: 1月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Friends, welcome back to The Roundtable.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，欢迎回到圆桌会议。

sentences.en: Maggie, Zolin, David, thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 玛吉、佐林、大卫，谢谢你们来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Last time the three of you were on the show, your locations were incredibly exotic.
sentences.zh: 你们三人上次上节目时，你们的所在地极其异国情调。

sentences.en: Mar-a-Lago, Italy.
sentences.zh: 海湖庄园，意大利。

sentences.en: Where were you, Maggie?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里，玛吉？

sentences.en: Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: Today, we join you from two boring studios on the East CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们从东海岸两个沉闷的演播室向大家问好。

sentences.en: We are taping this on Thursday afternoon at the end of week one of the Trump presidency, and what a week it has been.
sentences.zh: 我们在周四下午录制节目，当时正值特朗普总统执政的第一周结束，这一周可真不平静。

sentences.en: I don't think it's a stretch to say that in record time,
sentences.zh: 我认为这样说并不过分：在创纪录的时间内，

sentences.en: President Trump has begun to remake both the federal government and arguably American society in his image in just a few days.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在短短几天内就开始按照自己的形象重塑联邦政府，可以说是重塑了美国社会。

sentences.en: And I want to start with late-breaking policy that we haven't covered on the show from the White House, and that is around DEI, diversity, equity, and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 我想从我们节目尚未报道的、来自白宫的最新政策开始，也就是关于DEI，即多元、平等与包容。

sentences.en: What exactly, Zolin, had the policy been, and what has Trump just changed it to?
sentences.zh: 佐林，之前的政策究竟是什么样的，特朗普刚刚把它改成了什么？

sentences.en: So, basically, throughout the federal government, all the different cabinet agencies, you had these different programs that were focused on increasing diversity.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，在整个联邦政府中，所有不同的内阁机构，你都有这些致力于提高多元化的不同项目。

sentences.en: In the previous administration's mind, it was programs that would basically be addressing decades of systemic inequalities and racism.
sentences.zh: 在前届政府看来，这些项目基本上是为了解决几十年来系统性的不平等和种族主义。

sentences.en: And it's worth also saying this DEI has ramped up recently, but it's not necessarily new, came out of legislation in the 60s, what have you.
sentences.zh: 还值得一提的是，这个DEI最近有所加剧，但它并非完全新鲜事物，源于60年代的立法等等。

sentences.en: Trump comes into office, and one of his executive orders essentially calls this immoral
sentences.zh: 特朗普一上台，他的行政命令之一基本上称此为不道德，

sentences.en: and saying that under the guise of diversity that actually this is promoting inequality, right?
sentences.zh: 并称以多元化为幌子，实际上是在助长不平等，对吧？

sentences.en: Just in recent days, his administration has taken a number of actions, right?
sentences.zh: 就在最近几天，他的政府采取了一系列行动，对吧？

sentences.en: So, that includes a directive to put those that are working and leading DEI initiatives on paid leave.
sentences.zh: 因此，这包括一项指令，让那些工作并领导DEI倡议的人员带薪休假。

sentences.en: It also includes sending out memos to each agency, basically asking different federal employees
sentences.zh: 这还包括向各机构发送备忘录，基本上要求不同的联邦雇员

sentences.en: to report any indication or any work that may be in progress that is in line with DEI initiatives.
sentences.zh: 报告任何迹象或任何可能正在进行中、符合DEI倡议的工作。

sentences.en: I've talked to federal employees who have said that this makes them feel as if they have to almost turn in their own peers who might be working on this broad term as well.
sentences.zh: 我曾与联邦雇员交谈过，他们表示这让他们觉得几乎不得不检举那些可能也在从事这个广义概念工作的同行。

sentences.en: And that sent a chilling effect in the private sector as well, where now you have companies that are basically trying to decide,
sentences.zh: 这也对私营部门产生了寒蝉效应，现在那里的公司基本上在试图决定：

sentences.en: do we still maintain these programs that were meant to promote diversity?
sentences.zh: 我们还要保留这些旨在促进多元化的项目吗？

sentences.en: Do we shy away from it?
sentences.zh: 我们是要避开它吗？

sentences.en: Do we rename it?
sentences.zh: 我们要给它重新命名吗？

sentences.en: Is it just that the acronym is toxic in itself?
sentences.zh: 难道仅仅是这个缩写本身就有毒吗？

sentences.en: You've seen multiple actions at this point to follow through on what during the campaign was fiery rhetoric,
sentences.zh: 此时你已经看到多项行动来兑现竞选期间的激烈言辞，

sentences.en: but now seems to be an attempt to be at least one piece of reshaping this administration in a way that's aligned with the president.
sentences.zh: 但现在似乎是在尝试至少从一个方面以符合总统的方式重塑本届政府。

sentences.en: I want to make sure I understand how widespread DEI programs and personnel have been in the government to understand the impact of these executive orders,
sentences.zh: 为了理解这些试图根除它的行政命令和行动的影响，基本上是禁止它的行动，以及鼓励员工举报现在被禁的DEI执行尝试的行动，我想确保我理解DEI项目和人员在政府中有多普遍。

sentences.en: the executive orders and actions that attempt to root it out, essentially to forbid it,
sentences.zh: 为了理解这些试图根除它的行政命令和行动的影响，基本上是禁止它的行动，以及鼓励员工举报现在被禁的DEI执行尝试的行动，我想确保我理解DEI项目和人员在政府中有多普遍。

sentences.en: and the ones that attempt to encourage employees to report on essentially what's now banned attempts at enforcing DEI.
sentences.zh: 为了理解这些试图根除它的行政命令和行动的影响，基本上是禁止它的行动，以及鼓励员工举报现在被禁的DEI执行尝试的行动，我想确保我理解DEI项目和人员在政府中有多普遍。

sentences.en: Who among you has a sense of just how much government we're talking about here?
sentences.zh: 你们当中谁对我们这里谈论的政府规模有多少有个概念？

sentences.en: My sense is that it is actually not that gigantic a portion of the federal government, but it does exist in various pockets of agencies.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，它实际上并不是联邦政府中那么巨大的一个部分，但它确实存在于各个机构的角落里。

sentences.en: It shouldn't be surprising.
sentences.zh: 这不应该令人意外。

sentences.en: Trump did say all of this, as Nolan said, during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 正如诺兰所说，特朗普在竞选期间确实说过这一切。

sentences.en: He is doing what he said he was going to do.
sentences.zh: 他正在做他说过他要做的事。

sentences.en: But what is striking is this climate of fear that has been created within the federal government to say not just are we getting rid of these programs,
sentences.zh: 但令人震惊的是联邦政府内部营造的这种恐惧气氛，不仅说我们要摆脱这些项目，

sentences.en: but we are looking for who might be trying to work against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且我们正在寻找可能试图与唐纳德·特朗普作对的人。

sentences.en: Somebody made the point to me that if you worked in the federal government, there were two things in the past that you were asked to call in and snitch about,
sentences.zh: 有人向我指出，如果你在联邦政府工作，过去有两件事要求你打电话告密：

sentences.en: one of which is if you had a suspected spy who might be, you know, leaking classified information to the Russians or the Chinese or the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是如果你有一个可疑的间谍，他可能，你知道，在向俄罗斯人、中国人或伊朗人泄露机密信息。

sentences.en: And the second was corruption.
sentences.zh: 第二个是腐败。

sentences.en: And now we've created a third category, which is you might secretly be working on a DEI program.
sentences.zh: 现在我们创建了第三个类别，那就是你可能在秘密从事DEI项目。

sentences.en: It's worth remembering, too, that the previous administration signed executive orders to put racial equity essentially at the center of almost all their
sentences.zh: 同样值得记住的是，前届政府签署了行政命令，将种族平等基本上置于他们几乎所有政策制定的核心，

sentences.en: policymaking, including the hiring practices, you know, of the administration and just how sort of the structure of each agency, too.
sentences.zh: 包括政府的招聘做法，你知道，以及每个机构的结构等等。

sentences.en: So even if your job doesn't say DEI, you know, even if it doesn't say it on your title, the fear here is palpable because people, even if you were working on, say, infrastructure
sentences.zh: 因此，即使你的工作没有写明DEI，你知道，即使你的头衔上没有写，这里的恐惧也是显而易见的，因为人们，即使你从事的是，比方说，基础设施投资或，你知道，气候项目，过去四年里仍然关注着那里的种族平等。

sentences.en: investing or, you know, climate programs, there was still a focus on racial equity there the past four years.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的机构雇员几乎在想，你知道，他们会不会是以某种方式下一个轮到的人？

sentences.en: So you do have agency employees here almost wondering, you know, will they be next in a way?
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的机构雇员几乎在想，你知道，他们会不会是以某种方式下一个轮到的人？

sentences.en: And there was a place where you've seen it the most, Michael, which has been the Pentagon, right?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，有一个地方你看到得最多，那就是五角大楼，对吧？

sentences.en: So one of the first things they did was fire the admiral who was the commandant of the
sentences.zh: 因此，他们做的第一件事之一就是解雇了担任海岸警卫队司令的

sentences.en: Coast Guard.
sentences.zh: 海军上将。

sentences.en: And the argument was that she was placing DEI principles above all others for defending the country.
sentences.zh: 其论点是，她将DEI原则置于保卫国家的其他所有原则之上。

sentences.en: But you've heard it also in confirmation hearings, including for Pete Hegseth, who basically made the argument that he is going to focus on the warfighter firSt. And this is at
sentences.zh: 但你在听证会上也听到了这种说法，包括皮特·海格塞斯的听证会，他基本上提出了这样的论点：他将把重点放在一线战斗人员身上。这是

sentences.en: the core of his argument that women shouldn't be in combat.
sentences.zh: 他核心论点的一部分，即女性不应该上战场。

sentences.en: I want to be sure that we meet this argument from whether it's Pete Hegseth or Donald Trump or Elon
sentences.zh: 我想确保我们从皮特·海格塞斯、唐纳德·特朗普或埃隆·马斯克各自的角度来应对这一论点。

sentences.en: Musk on its own terMs. And I listened, David, to Pete Hegseth talk about this.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我听了皮特·海格塞斯对此的谈论。

sentences.en: The way he put it was that he wanted to be sure that standards for everyone in the military were equal, not equitable.
sentences.zh: 他的说法是，他希望确保军中每个人的标准是平等的，而不是讲求结果公平的。

sentences.en: And this is a quote.
sentences.zh: 这是一句原话。

sentences.en: That's a very different word.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完全不同的词。

sentences.en: And in his inaugural speech, what
sentences.zh: 在他就职演说中，特朗普总统所说的是，

sentences.en: President Trump said is he would forge a society, this is a quote that is colorblind and merit-based.
sentences.zh: 他将打造一个不分肤色、唯才是举的社会，这是一句原话。

sentences.en: What I hear them saying is that diversity as something to be prized and sought in its own right is out.
sentences.zh: 我听到他们说的是，将多元化作为一种本身值得珍视和追求的事物已经过时了。

sentences.en: What's in, they're saying, is a merit-based system in which diversity might be an outcome, but it's never the goal.
sentences.zh: 他们说，取而代之的是一个唯才是举的系统，在这个系统中多元化可能是一个结果，但绝不是目标。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 我认为完全正确。

sentences.en: Merit-based has been something that we have heard repeatedly from Donald Trump, from other people in his new administration.
sentences.zh: 唯才是举是我们从唐纳德·特朗普以及他新政府中的其他人那里听到多次的说法。

sentences.en: And the idea is supposed to be that everybody starts out equal.
sentences.zh: 这个理念本应是每个人都从同一起跑线开始。

sentences.en: And as you say, if you end up in a place that happens to be diverse, that's just because the people who rose were, in Donald Trump's telling, equipped for those roles.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，如果你最终到达了一个碰巧很多元的职位，那只是因为脱颖而出的人在唐纳德·特朗普看来具备胜任这些角色的能力。

sentences.en: However, what it does is ignore the notion that there is anything such as systemic racism or that people who are of color have historically not been necessarily looked at the
sentences.zh: 然而，这样做却忽视了这样一种观念：即存在任何诸如系统性种族主义的东西，或者有色人种在历史上不一定受到同样的看待，或者没有获得公平的机会或拥有相同的机会。

sentences.en: same way or given an equal shake or had the same opportunities.
sentences.zh: 然而，这样做却忽视了这样一种观念：即存在任何诸如系统性种族主义的东西，或者有色人种在历史上不一定受到同样的看待，或者没有获得公平的机会或拥有相同的机会。

sentences.en: And it's not surprising to see that
sentences.zh: 看到唐纳德·特朗普实施这一计划并不令人意外，

sentences.en: Donald Trump is enacting this plan, but it has been pretty sweeping.
sentences.zh: 但它确实非常全面。

sentences.en: Clearly, what stood out to many people about the way Trump approached this whole issue was the element of, tell us about colleagues who are doing this thing when they shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 显然，在特朗普处理整个问题的方式中，最令许多人瞩目的元素是：告诉我们哪些同事在不该做的时候正在做这件事。

sentences.en: To some, it had kind of shades of McCarthyism, rat out your colleagues.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，这有点麦卡锡主义的影子，揭发你的同事。

sentences.en: And Maggie, you have spent a fair amount of time over the past few days reporting on a related subject, which is the ways in which the
sentences.zh: 玛吉，过去几天你花了不少时间报道一个相关的主题，那就是总统及其身边的人开始在某种程度上系统性地针对那些他们不希望留在这个政府中的人，甚至包括那些他们视为不忠、想要剥夺其特权的前特朗普官员。

sentences.en: president and those around him are starting to somewhat systematically target people they don't
sentences.zh: 总统及其身边的人开始在某种程度上系统性地针对那些他们不希望留在这个政府中的人，甚至包括那些他们视为不忠、想要剥夺其特权的前特朗普官员。

sentences.en: want to be in this administration and even former Trump officials who they see as disloyal, who they want to begin to take perks away from.
sentences.zh: 总统及其身边的人开始在某种程度上系统性地针对那些他们不希望留在这个政府中的人，甚至包括那些他们视为不忠、想要剥夺其特权的前特朗普官员。

sentences.en: So I would say a couple of things, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我想说几点。

sentences.en: Number one, there have been all kinds of bottlenecks for hiring for various places across the Trump administration because the loyalty tests that
sentences.zh: 第一，特朗普政府各地职位的招聘遇到了各种瓶颈，因为对候选人应用的忠诚度测试不仅非常严格，

sentences.en: are being applied to prospective candidates are not just very intense and people are being asked a series of questions like who won the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 而且人们被问到一系列问题，比如谁赢得了2020年大选？

sentences.en: How do you feel about January 6th, 2021?
sentences.zh: 你对2021年1月6日有什么看法？

sentences.en: But the perception of loyalty is completely dependent on how Donald Trump views it at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 但对忠诚度的感知完全取决于唐纳德·特朗普在任何特定时刻的看法。

sentences.en: So he has all kinds of people in his government who have said critical things about him in the past,
sentences.zh: 因此，他的政府里有各种过去曾对他说过批评话语的人，

sentences.en: including his secretary of state, Marco Rubio, who ran against him in 2016, made fun of his hand size.
sentences.zh: 包括他的国务卿马可·鲁比奥，他在2016年与他竞选时曾嘲笑他的手掌大小。

sentences.en: But you have now people who can't be hired if they worked for Mike Pompeo, who Trump hired in his- To be the head of CIA.
sentences.zh: 但现在有些人如果曾为迈克·蓬佩奥工作就无法被录用，特朗普曾雇用他担任——中央情报局局长。

sentences.en: And the secretary of state in his first administration.
sentences.zh: 以及他第一任期内的国务卿。

sentences.en: If you work for Mike Pompeo, you can't come in.
sentences.zh: 如果你为迈克·蓬佩奥工作，你就进不来。

sentences.en: If you work for Mike Pence, you can't come in.
sentences.zh: 如果你为迈克·彭斯工作，你就进不来。

sentences.en: It goes on and on and on like this.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类，没完没了。

sentences.en: You're saying these loyalty tests are very arbitrary.
sentences.zh: 你是说这些忠诚度测试非常武断。

sentences.en: It's making it hard to hire.
sentences.zh: 这让招聘变得困难。

sentences.en: And it's based on whoever is kind of up or down in Trump's mind at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 而且它是基于在任何特定时刻特朗普心目中谁正处于上风或下风。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And whoever is whispering in Trump's ear about that other person at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 以及在任何特定时刻在特朗普耳边说另一个人坏话的人。

sentences.en: Relatedly, he has stripped so far three that we know of, former senior officials from his first term of security protection that the Biden administration had granted them based on
sentences.zh: 与此相关的是，到目前为止，据我们所知，他已经剥夺了第一任期内三位前高级官员的安全保护，而拜登政府根据情报界对来自伊朗的持续威胁的评估曾授予他们这些保护。

sentences.en: intelligence community assessments of ongoing threats from Iran.
sentences.zh: 而拜登政府根据情报界对来自伊朗的持续威胁的评估曾授予他们这些保护。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Which former officials, and I'm assuming this relates to the question of loyalty, what did they do to make Trump feel they were disloyal?
sentences.zh: 哪些前官员，我猜这与忠诚度问题有关，他们做了什么让特朗普觉得他们不忠？

sentences.en: John Bolton, who was Trump's third national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 约翰·博尔顿，他是特朗普的第三任国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: Bolton's sin in Trump's eyes was writing a very detailed insider account of his time as national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿在特朗普眼中的罪过是写了一部非常详细的内部记述，记录了他在担任国家安全顾问期间的经历。

sentences.en: It did not paint Trump in a good light.
sentences.zh: 这本书并没有把特朗普描绘成好形象。

sentences.en: He's been very critical of Trump since leaving.
sentences.zh: 他离职后对特朗普一直非常批评。

sentences.en: They have had a very, very extensive falling out.
sentences.zh: 他们已经彻底决裂了。

sentences.en: That one was not surprising, but it still put John Bolton at risk.
sentences.zh: 那一个并不令人意外，但它仍然让约翰·博尔顿处于危险之中。

sentences.en: It's less easy to explain why he has such antipathy for Mike
sentences.zh: 很难解释为什么他对迈克·蓬佩奥（他的第二任国务卿）以及来自国务院的迈克·蓬佩奥的另一位助手布赖恩·胡克怀有如此强烈的反感。

sentences.en: Pompeo, his second secretary of state, and another aide to Mike Pompeo from the State Department,
sentences.zh: 他的第二任国务卿，以及来自国务院的迈克·蓬佩奥的另一位助手布赖恩·胡克。

sentences.en: Brian Hook.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩·胡克。

sentences.en: All these people have lost their security.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人，他们都失去了安全保障。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They have loSt. And they had a different type of security than Bolton did.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了。而且他们受到的安全保护类型与博尔顿不同。

sentences.en: Theirs was provided by the State Department.
sentences.zh: 他们的是由国务院提供的。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, they also faced real threats.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，他们也面临着真实的威胁。

sentences.en: And again, they are facing these threats because of actions they took in the service of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，他们面临这些威胁是因为他们为唐纳德·特朗普服务时采取的行动。

sentences.en: And now
sentences.zh: 而现在

sentences.en: Donald Trump is saying, you're on your own.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普却说，你们自求多福吧。

sentences.en: You were just talking, Maggie, about also just how much loyalty is important to this president
sentences.zh: 玛吉，你刚才还在谈论，当涉及到他带来的人以及他正在做的行动时，忠诚度对这位总统来说有多么重要。

sentences.en: when it comes to the people that he brings in, when it comes to the actions that he's doing.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到他带来的人以及他正在做的行动时，忠诚度对这位总统来说有多么重要。

sentences.en: It is just interesting to square the argument of our previous topic of, you know, going after these
sentences.zh: 将我们之前的话题——为了拥有一个更加唯才是举的政府而去打击这些DEI项目的论点——与这位总统同时也被我们所知正在对新进人员进行忠诚度测试的做法结合起来看，这确实很有趣。

sentences.en: DEI programs to have a government that's more based off merit, when at the same time, this president also, we know, is doing loyalty tests for people coming in.
sentences.zh: 与这位总统同时也被我们所知正在对新进人员进行忠诚度测试的做法结合起来看，这确实很有趣。

sentences.en: That's not exactly merit.
sentences.zh: 这算不上真正的唯才是举。

sentences.en: That's not merit as a top priority.
sentences.zh: 这不是把才能放在首位。

sentences.en: That's loyalty as a top priority.
sentences.zh: 这是把忠诚放在首位。

sentences.en: Here's the oddity that I find here.
sentences.zh: 这里有我发现的奇怪之处。

sentences.en: I can understand this for political appointees.
sentences.zh: 我可以理解政治任命人员是这样的。

sentences.en: Everybody wants political appointees who are aligned with your vision of how to conduct the government.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想要与你如何管理政府的愿景相一致的政治任命人员。

sentences.en: But the loyalty tests are also being applied to younger career officials.
sentences.zh: 但这种忠诚度测试也延伸到了更年轻的职业官员身上。

sentences.en: So what we saw happen at the National Security Council on Wednesday...
sentences.zh: 那么我们看到周三在国家安全委员会发生的事情是……

sentences.en: Where a bunch of folks were let go.
sentences.zh: 有一群人被解雇了。

sentences.en: Well, they weren't let go yet, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们还没被解雇，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It was interesting.
sentences.zh: 很有意思。

sentences.en: They were gathered on a two or three minute Zoom call.
sentences.zh: 他们被召集在一个两三分钟的Zoom会议上。

sentences.en: This was well over a hundred career people who work at the National
sentences.zh: 这可是远超一百名在国家安全委员会工作的职业人员，

sentences.en: Security Council, but actually are detailed from the State Department, the Pentagon, the CIA.
sentences.zh: 但实际上他们是分别来自国务院、五角大楼和中情局的借调人员。

sentences.en: And they were told, go home.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知，回家去。

sentences.en: Don't call us.
sentences.zh: 不要打电话给我们。

sentences.en: We'll call you.
sentences.zh: 我们会打给你们。

sentences.en: Don't go on your email.
sentences.zh: 不要查看邮箱。

sentences.en: Don't do any work.
sentences.zh: 不要做任何工作。

sentences.en: And we're going to tell you whether you still have your job.
sentences.zh: 我们会告诉你们是否还保住了工作。

sentences.en: And they all have the sense that their social media is being examined, that people are being interviewed to hear, have you ever heard them say something critical of Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 他们都有一种感觉，觉得自己的社交媒体正在被审查，人们正在被盘问，听听他们是否说过批评唐纳德·特朗普的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, taken together, the moves on DEI, especially the encouragement to turn in colleagues who are still doing DEI work now that it's forbidden,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，综合来看，在多元、平等与包容（DEI）项目上的举措，尤其是由于现在DEI工作已被禁止，而鼓励举报仍在从事该工作的同事，

sentences.en: the firings, the removal of security for former Trump officials who are facing real threats but are seen as disloyal.
sentences.zh: 以及解雇行为，还有撤销那些面临真正威胁却被视为不忠诚的前特朗普官员的安全保护。

sentences.en: I was about to ask you what it all adds up to, but I think that would be an abdication of my role as synthesizer.
sentences.zh: 我正想问你这一切到底意味着什么，但我想这有违我作为总结者的职责。

sentences.en: I think what it clearly adds up to is dissent will not be remotely tolerated in this second Trump term.
sentences.zh: 我认为这显然意味着在特朗普的第二个总统任期内，将完全容不下任何异见。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's correct.
sentences.zh: 是的，正是如此。

sentences.en: Look, Trump believes, and he has in some cases reason to believe, that people working within his government, career bureaucrats in his first term, were working against his agenda.
sentences.zh: 听着，特朗普坚信——在某些情况下他也有理由相信——在他第一个任期内，在其政府内部工作的那些职业官僚一直在与他的议程作对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not just flagging concerns, but in other cases actively trying to stop him from implementing certain policies that he had campaigned on and wanted, and he is the president.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是提出担忧，在其他情况下甚至积极阻挠他推行自己曾参与竞选并希望实施的某些政策，而且他才是总统。

sentences.en: He is able to do that.
sentences.zh: 他有能力做到这一点。

sentences.en: That's different than this, which is, we don't want any hint of independence or independent thinking, or you're at suspicion because you may have said X, Y, Z.
sentences.zh: 这与眼下的情况不同，眼下的情况是：我们不希望看到一丝一毫的独立性或独立思考，否则你就会因为可能说过这样那样的话而遭到怀疑。

sentences.en: This is just something totally different.
sentences.zh: 这完全是两码事。

sentences.en: And, you know, we talked about McCarthy earlier.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们刚才谈到了麦卡锡。

sentences.en: McCarthy's protege was Roy Cohn, and Roy Cohn, the fixer and lawyer, was Donald Trump's mentor.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡的门徒是罗伊·科恩，而身为幕后操盘手和律师的罗伊·科恩，正是唐纳德·特朗普的导师。

sentences.en: And you're saying that it's sort of in Trump's DNA to ferret out those who would in any way get in his way, kind of stem to root, root to stem.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，把那些任何可能挡路的人连根拔起、彻底清除，这种做法某种程度上已经刻在了特朗普的DNA里。

sentences.en: Not just ferret them out, but make them afraid of what might happen to them if they don't go along with what he wants.
sentences.zh: 不仅是把他们揪出来，还要让他们害怕如果不顺从他的意愿会有什么下场。

sentences.en: On that, we're going to go to a break.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我们要先休息一下。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com slash games开始游玩。

sentences.en: Okay, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好的，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: I want to turn now to presidential pardons.
sentences.zh: 我现在想把话题转向总统特赦。

sentences.en: In the days since President Trump issued these blanket pardons and commutations, we've gotten a sense of just how blanket they actually are because three of the
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统发布这些一揽子特赦和减刑令之后的几天里，我们逐渐意识到这些特赦的范围究竟有多广，因为有三位

sentences.en: people who were given the longest prison sentences for their role in the assault on the Capitol have come out of prison.
sentences.zh: 因参与国会山骚乱而被判处最长刑期的刑满释放人员已经出狱了。

sentences.en: Enrique Tarrio, ex-leader of the Proud Boys, who had been sentenced to 22 years for seditious conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 恩里克·塔里奥，骄傲男孩的前领袖，曾因煽动阴谋罪被判处22年监禁。

sentences.en: Stuart Rhodes of the Oath Keepers sentenced to 18 years for the same charge.
sentences.zh: 誓言守护者的斯图尔特·罗兹因相同罪名被判处18年监禁。

sentences.en: Joe Biggs sentenced to 17 years for that charge of seditious conspiracy, which pretty much the most serious crime you can be accused of committing against your own government.
sentences.zh: 乔·比格斯因煽动阴谋罪被判处17年监禁，这可以说是你被指控对自己的政府犯下的最严重的罪行。

sentences.en: Maggie, do you think Trump knew who was going to be released when he issued these blanket commutations and pardons, given what we're now learning?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，鉴于我们现在了解到的情况，你认为特朗普在发布这些一揽子减刑和特赦时，知道谁会被释放吗？

sentences.en: I think Trump was well aware of what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普很清楚自己在做什么。

sentences.en: I know, based on reporting that we have all done, that there was extensive conversation within his world about what the options were for releasing various people.
sentences.zh: 根据我们大家所做的报道，我知道他的核心圈子内部曾就释放各类人员的选项进行过广泛的讨论。

sentences.en: There were at least two executive orders drafted as to what types of pardon there would be.
sentences.zh: 至少起草了多份关于将实行何种特赦的行政命令。

sentences.en: There was a discussion about, do you exclude the people who were convicted of seditious conspiracy, for instance.
sentences.zh: 当时曾讨论过，比如是否要将因煽动阴谋罪被定罪的人排除在外。

sentences.en: Trump's team is well aware that there were people who were convicted or caught on video beating up police officers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的团队非常清楚，确实有人被定罪或在视频中被拍到殴打警察。

sentences.en: Trump himself had said during the campaign as a way of avoiding getting pinned down on this, that he was going to go on a case-by-case basis.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人在竞选期间曾说过，为了避免在这件事上被逼入绝境，他将视具体情况个案处理。

sentences.en: And I don't think he was ever going to go on a case-by-case basis.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他从来没打算按个案处理。

sentences.en: I think that he went in the direction that he always wanted to go in.
sentences.zh: 我认为他最终走向了他一直想去的那条路。

sentences.en: Could he recite chapter and verse what everybody was convicted of?
sentences.zh: 他能一字不差地背出每个人是因为什么罪名被定罪的吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不能。

sentences.en: But I think he has pretty clear understanding of the depth of the criminality described.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他对所涉犯罪行为的严重程度有着相当清晰的理解。

sentences.en: It's a pretty extraordinary, David, reimagining of the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 大卫，这可以说是对法治的一种相当非同寻常的重新构想。

sentences.en: Is that perhaps too delicate a phrasing?
sentences.zh: 这个说法会不会太委婉了点？

sentences.en: Well, I think there are three things going on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有三件事正在发生。

sentences.en: I don't think it's too delicate a phrasing at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不觉得这个说法太委婉。

sentences.en: First of all, this is part of the completion of his rewriting of the history of January 6th, right?
sentences.zh: 首先，这是他重写1月6日历史这一宏大工程的一部分，对吧？

sentences.en: If his argument was it was a day of love, then there was really nothing to convict them for.
sentences.zh: 如果他的论点那是充满爱的一天，那么实际上就没什么好对他们定罪的了。

sentences.en: And he never actually, in talking about it, did the balancing test between these acts of sedition that the most serious of the cases were charged with or the attacks on the police.
sentences.zh: 而且他在谈论此事时，从未真正做过权衡：一方面是最严重案件所指控的煽动叛乱行为或对警察的袭击，另一方面是其他因素。

sentences.en: He simply said, well, they've served a lot of time in jail.
sentences.zh: 他只是说，哦，他们在监狱里服刑很久了。

sentences.en: Well, they've served a fraction of their sentences.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们只服了刑期的一小部分。

sentences.en: So that's the firSt. The second is the symbolism of doing this in the opening days of a new presidency.
sentences.zh: 所以这是第一点。第二点是在新总统任期初期的几天里做这件事的象征意义。

sentences.en: Usually presidents wait till the end of the year, Christmas, or the end of their term.
sentences.zh: 通常总统们会等到年底、圣诞节或者任期结束时再做。

sentences.en: The final hours, yeah.
sentences.zh: 最后几个小时，是的。

sentences.en: This was highly unusual to have these pardons happen at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 在开始阶段就发布这些特赦是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to those who are most suspicious of President Trump's motives, they think that he wants an outside
sentences.zh: 对于那些对特朗普总统的动机抱有最大怀疑的人来说，他们认为他是想建立一个外部

sentences.en: group, militia, defenders, whatever you would call them, who are now free to go defend his interests out there and who now know that they can be pardoned.
sentences.zh: 群体、民兵、卫士，无论你怎么称呼他们，现在他们可以自由地去捍卫他的利益，并且现在他们知道自己是可以被特赦的。

sentences.en: I just want to make explicit what I think you're saying.
sentences.zh: 我只是想把我认为你所表达的意思明确说出来。

sentences.en: There are now freed loyalists of Trump who owe their freedom to him, you're suggesting, who may now operate distinctly in his defense in whatever way they think necessary.
sentences.zh: 你是在暗示，现在有获得自由的特朗普忠诚者，他们将自由归功于他，他们现在可能会以他们认为必要的任何方式明确地为他辩护。

sentences.en: And may feel particularly loyal to him because he let them out of jail in the opening days of his
sentences.zh: 并且可能会对特别忠于他，因为他在其政府上台的头几天放他们出狱，并且无论对错都坚信

sentences.en: administration and believe, whether they are right or wrong, that that gives them freedom to go defend him in any way that they see necessary.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了他们以自己认为必要的任何方式去捍卫他的自由。

sentences.en: And the president's going to be asked about this topic.
sentences.zh: 总统将会被问及这个话题。

sentences.en: You know, he already has been asked about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他其实已经被问过了。

sentences.en: And in the White House, while he was signing an executive order, he was pressed and asked,
sentences.zh: 在白宫签署一项行政命令时，他遭到追问并被问到：

sentences.en: now that you've done these pardons, do you think there's essentially a place for the Proud Boys, for these groups, quote, in the political conversation?
sentences.zh: 既然你已经批准了这些特赦，你认为对于骄傲男孩这些组织，用引用的话说，在政治对话中基本上还有他们的容身之地吗？

sentences.en: And the president responded by saying, well, we'll have to see and then criticize their sentencing as well.
sentences.zh: 总统的回应是，嗯，我们得走着瞧，然后他还顺便批评了对他们的判决。

sentences.en: So we'll have to watch too now that this has happened.
sentences.zh: 所以既然事情已经发生了，我们也得拭目以待。

sentences.en: Will the president of the United States also continue to amplify these groups as well?
sentences.zh: 这位美国总统是否还会继续放大这些群体的声音？

sentences.en: Can I just make one point, though?
sentences.zh: 不过我能补充一点吗？

sentences.en: Please, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 请讲，玛吉。

sentences.en: Trump is clearly betting because that is how it has played out almost every single time that he has been warned that something he was
sentences.zh: 特朗普显然在押注——因为每当他被警告说他要做的事将会对自身产生不利后果时，几乎每一次事情最终都证明

sentences.en: going to do was going to have adverse consequences for himself.
sentences.zh: 他都在押注——他可以把事情拖过去，负面舆论最终会平息。

sentences.en: He is betting that he can wait it out and the bad publicity will go away.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，到目前为止，从我看到的相当平淡的反应来看，包括那些不仅曾预测他不会

sentences.en: And I have to say that so far, based on the pretty muted reaction that I'm seeing, including from Republican lawmakers who had not just predicted that he wasn't going to
sentences.zh: 这么做，但在1月6日那天许多人不得不仓皇逃命以保全性命的共和党议员们，几乎什么都没说。

sentences.en: do this, but in many cases had to run for their safety on January 6th, have said almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 因此他往往押注公众舆论会发生转变或改变，或者至少不会起来反抗他。

sentences.en: And so he tends to bet that public opinion will shift or change or at least not, you know, revolt against him.
sentences.zh: 过去四年里，事实证明确实如此。

sentences.en: And that's proven true over the last four years.
sentences.zh: 而且，玛吉，当那些共和党议员确实对这些特赦发表评论时，他们反复使用了一个词组。

sentences.en: And when, Maggie, those Republican lawmakers have said something about these pardons, they've used a phrase over and over again.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们好像所有人都在房间里开会商量好了这个词组一样。

sentences.en: It felt like they had all gotten together in the room and decided on the phrase.
sentences.zh: 这个词组就是：我们要向前看，而不是向后看。
